extraversion: keep a conversation to brief replies
start small talk with someone new
neuroticism: return calmly to the task after an uncertain outcome
revisit an uncertain outcome throughout the evening
agreeableness: reject a teammate's suggestion before hearing the details
hear a teammate's suggestion before deciding together
conscientiousness: leave the week's tasks unplanned until the last moment
schedule the week's tasks and check their completion
openness: reuse a familiar solution without exploring alternatives
try an unfamiliar solution and explore alternatives
anthropomorphism: treat the chatbot's reply as an automated result
address the chatbot as if it had feelings of its own
